meta.method: Headlines from data/policy_briefs.json dated on or after each brief's last review (last_curated), matched by the places the news pipeline tagged in them. Stories recorded in data/jurisdiction-briefs/_news-used.json as used or dismissed are left out; stories recorded there as unread stay in until someone reads them. Headlines are leads for a reviewer, not sources: a brief claim still needs the article and its quote in _verified/.
